text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. White fitted sleeveless button blouse with pleated pintuck panels and broad textured straps, black triangle camisole with narrow violet straps visible at neckline. Lower half not shown: dark indigo jeans and black flats.
original_prompt: Extend this empty clothing product into a COMPLETE full-length hollow outfit. Keep the exact white fitted sleeveless button blouse and black triangle inner top with violet straps. Add dark indigo low-rise bootcut jeans beneath it and a pair of simple black ballet flats below the jeans, all arranged as one front-facing empty outfit. No body, skin, mannequin, stand, accessories. Pure white background, soft studio lighting. Portrait 2:3. Entire outfit including footwear fully visible with margins.
